hook: orphan 思索團進實驗室：cogitate／envisage／chimera／conjure——白板上畫了三個問號和一隻想像怪獸。
script: cogitate／excogitate 沉思。envisage 設想。chimera 幻想。conjure 想起／變出。deliberate 深思熟慮。口令：白板寫「想清楚」，怪獸寫「別當真」。

members.senseAnchor: consider carefully and deeply; reflect upon; turn over in one's mind; use or exercise the mind or one's power of reason in order to make inferences, decisions, or arrive at a solution or judgments
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 托腮: cogitate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「托腮」出場：cogitate 一上場梗就黏住——沉思。

members.senseAnchor: come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort; reflect deeply on a subject
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 靈感燈泡: excogitate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「靈感燈泡」出場：excogitate 一上場梗就黏住——想出。

related.synonyms: invent, contrive, devise, formulate, forge, meditate

members.senseAnchor: form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 藍圖脑: envisage walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「藍圖脑」出場：envisage 一上場梗就黏住——設想。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 想像獸: chimera walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「想像獸」出場：chimera 一上場梗就黏住——幻想。

members.senseAnchor: to form a mental picture of
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 魔術手: conjure walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「魔術手」出場：conjure 一上場梗就黏住——想起變出。

members.senseAnchor: decide on as a result of careful thought
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 慢思考: deliberate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「慢思考」出場：deliberate 一上場梗就黏住——深思熟慮的。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 沉思帽: cogitant walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「沉思帽」出場：cogitant 一上場梗就黏住——沉思的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 反芻杯: rumination walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「反芻杯」出場：rumination 一上場梗就黏住——反芻思考。

members.senseAnchor: in ancient Greek mythology any of 9 daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne; protector of an art or science; the source of an artist's inspiration
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 望窗想: muse walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「望窗想」出場：muse 一上場梗就黏住——冥想。

related.synonyms: meditate, ponder, excogitate, contemplate, reflect, mull

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假設牌: speculate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假設牌」出場：speculate 一上場梗就黏住——推測。

members.senseAnchor: the process of examining your own thoughts or feelings
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鏡子想: introspection walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鏡子想」出場：introspection 一上場梗就黏住——內省。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 白板: whiteboard walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「白板」出場：whiteboard 一上場梗就黏住——白板。
